title: Show a useful error when copying installation snippets fails
prompt:
Change only src/app/install/page.tsx among production files. Evidence: src/app/install/page.tsx:165; CopyButton at lines 161-178 unconditionally calls navigator.clipboard.writeText at line 165 and handles only fulfillment. When clipboard access is unavailable, clicking Copy throws synchronously; a denied write rejects without visible feedback. The actual rendered CopyButton was invoked with navigator.clipboard missing and threw on writeText, leaving a user unsure how to obtain the installation snippet.

Guard unavailable clipboard support and handle both synchronous failures and rejected writes. Show a concise, accessible failure message telling the user to select and copy the visible snippet manually. Report Copied only after fulfillment, allow retry, and clear an earlier error when a later attempt succeeds. Preserve snippet contents, client tabs, and the existing successful-copy reset behavior.

Add only tests/install-copy-feedback.test.ts using node:test and an in-memory TypeScript transpilation of the page. Obtain CopyButton from the rendered tree and mock its hooks, navigator, and timer. Cover unavailable clipboard, a throwing implementation, a rejected promise, successful copy with the exact supplied text, and successful retry after failure. Assert rendered feedback rather than source-string matches. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/install-copy-feedback.test.ts. Keep dependencies unchanged and use only mocked clipboard operations; work on the assigned branch you are on.
